content.text: The data clearly distinguishes the two causes. The **scheduled** setpoint stream (`Occupied_Air_Temperature_Cooling_Setpoint`) remains essentially flat (~24.5–24.7 °C) both before and after mid-June 2018, while the **commanded** setpoint (`Zone_Air_Cooling_Temperature_Setpoint`) tracks the schedule exactly through May 2018 and then drops ~1 °C below it starting in mid-June and stays there. A schedule change would show up as a shift in the scheduled setpoint stream itself, which is not the case. Instead, there is a constant ~1 °C gap between commanded and scheduled setpoints from mid-June onward — the signature of a controller offset being applied (or a local override set).
